Age and sex come from the request or the case's reviewed demographics, never from extracted text; without both the run is refused. Superclass labels aggregate cardiologist SCP statements; they are not adjudicated clinical diagnoses. Only 100 Hz, 10-second, 12-lead resting ECGs in the PTB-XL lead order are in scope. Platt calibration was fitted on the validation fold of the same source; probabilities are not calibrated for any clinical population. Research-only output; not validated for clinical use.

preprocessing_version: nifti-foreground-crop-channel-zscore-resample-v2
limitations: Internal held-out test on ISLES 2022 patients from the same centres as training; no external or clinical validation. Input: DWI and ADC on one grid, stacked in one 4-D NIfTI with DWI first, skull-stripped like the development data; FLAIR is not used. One development case was not skull-stripped, so the non-zero-share check cannot refuse a head with skull for this model. A predicted lesion is a research segmentation of diffusion restriction, not an infarct-core estimate for treatment selection. Small lesions are segmented less reliably (Dice by reference lesion volume is reported); false-positive components per case are reported. Trained on ischaemic stroke only: haemorrhage, tumour, infection and other causes of diffusion restriction are out of scope. Research-only output; not clinically validated and not for diagnosis or treatment decisions. Evaluation and serving use float16 autocast on CUDA with cuDNN autotuning; a rerun of training can differ slightly.
